comment: Triangle budgets for a train's cars. Sources: decision 417 (a car over 20,000 triangles needs a middle version; a 12-car train must leave room in the lower tier's 250,000), decision 420 and 432 (a far car has under half the near car's triangles and fits the same box), decision 408 (the far car is drawn car for car from 500 m).

grandfathered.comment: Sets on main when this tool was made that break a rule below. They stay as they are; a new model may not join the list. id -> reason.

noFar.STEAM: 1 car(s) of 8000+ triangles and no far version (decision 417)
